# Neowork Labs

> Neowork Labs is a creative studio based in Canberra, Australia, serving brands worldwide with video editing, graphic and character design, web development, and AI-generated ads.

## Services

- [Video editing](https://www.neoworklabs.com/services/video-editing): We edit raw footage into finished videos for social media, ads, and brand content.
- [Graphic & character design](https://www.neoworklabs.com/services/graphic-character-design): We design brand identities, marketing graphics, illustrations, and original characters.
- [Web development](https://www.neoworklabs.com/services/web-development): We design and build fast, responsive websites, from landing pages to web applications.
- [AI-generated ads](https://www.neoworklabs.com/services/ai-generated-ads): We produce video and image ads with AI models, so brands can test more creative variations.

## Pages
